defects.description: replicas.min (5) is greater than replicas.max (3), violating the stated constraint min <= max.
paraphrases: The minimum replica count exceeds the maximum (5 > 3), which is invalid.
replicas.min and replicas.max are inverted; min should not be larger than max.
The autoscaling bounds are impossible: floor of 5 with a ceiling of 3.
defects.rationale: Directly violates the min<=max constraint stated in the header; findable from the artifact alone.

defects.description: autoscale.target_cpu_percent is 130, outside the allowed range [1, 100].
paraphrases: A CPU target of 130% is out of the valid 1-100 percent range.
target_cpu_percent exceeds 100, which the stated constraint disallows.
The autoscale CPU threshold is set above its permitted maximum.
defects.rationale: Violates the [1,100] range stated in the header comment.

defects.description: The /refund route's backend `refunds-core` is not defined under `services` (only payments-core and ledger exist).
paraphrases: Route /refund points at an undefined service `refunds-core`.
`refunds-core` is referenced as a backend but never declared in the services list.
Dangling backend reference: the /refund route names a service that does not exist.
defects.rationale: Every backend must be a defined service (header constraint); refunds-core is not, and this is findable from the artifact.

defects.description: tls.enabled is false while environment is production, violating the constraint that TLS must be enabled in production.
paraphrases: Production is running with TLS disabled, which the stated policy forbids.
tls.enabled=false contradicts the requirement that production must use TLS.
A production deployment has transport encryption turned off.
defects.rationale: environment=production plus tls.enabled=false directly breaks the header's production-TLS constraint.
